title: Vendor asset lightweight acceptance & microcopy kit
body:
Purpose
A compact, pragmatic checklist and microcopy bank for vendor assets destined for cloud marketplaces. Use this when partners or internal teams are preparing lightweight listing materials and we need a quick acceptance pass that balances product fidelity with launch velocity.

Scope and when to use
- For small feature launches, trials, or partner pilot listings where marketing assets are minimal.
- Not a replacement for the full listing pack; this is the minimal acceptance kit to unblock staging and smoke tests.

Minimum required asset fields (fast accept)
1) Tile headline (max 70 chars)
2) One-line tagline / short description (max 140 chars)
3) Long description (200-600 chars, plain text)
4) Bullet list: 3 core benefits (each 60 char max)
5) 1-2 screenshots or simplified architecture diagram (PNG, 1280x720 preferred)
6) Icon (square, 512x512 transparent PNG)
7) Entitlement mapping: trial SKU or free tier flag (boolean)
8) Contact link: support email or quickbook URL
9) Billing SKU mapping note (internal)
10) Privacy/data residency flag and KMS requirement note if applicable

Microcopy bank (pick tone: developer, product, enterprise)
- Developer-forward headline: 'Ship LLM inference with predictable latency and cost'
- Product headline: 'High-throughput LLM inference optimized for production'
- Enterprise headline: 'SLA-backed inference for regulated workloads'

Short description examples (one-liners)
- 'Fast, cost-aware inference for text, chat, and embeddings.'
- 'Dedicated GPU pools, autoscaling, and simple API integration.'
- 'Private deployments with enterprise key management and audit logs.'

Long description skeleton (200-400 chars)
- Template A (developer): 'Redwood Inference delivers a single API for generation, embeddings, and rerank with predictable latency and transparent cost controls. Start quickly with hosted endpoints, and scale to dedicated or private deployments without changing your code.'
- Template B (enterprise): 'Meet compliance and performance needs with reserved capacity, private control plane options, and enterprise SLAs. Integrated observability and rollout controls help platform teams standardize inference across products.'

Feature bullets (concise)
- 'Hosted API for rapid prototyping'
- 'Reserved capacity and autoscaling'
- 'Private deployment with KMS support'

CTA variants
- 'Start free trial'
- 'Request a demo'
- 'Explore the API'

Telemetry and quick tags (must be wired in asset metadata)
- telemetry.event: listing.published (fire on publish)
- telemetry.tag: tile.variant (A|B)
- telemetry.metric: click_to_trial_rate
- quick tag values: payg|dedicated|private|trial

Acceptance criteria (smoke tests)
- Asset fields present and parseable by ingest lambda (headline, short desc, long desc, bullets).
- Icon loads at 512x512 without transparency artifacts.
- All links resolve to 200 or 302 within 2s in staging.
- Trial entitlement toggles create a provisioning ticket in billing sandbox.
- Basic content safety scan passes (no disallowed terms).
- Screenshot thumbnails generate at 320x180 correctly.

Common failure modes and fast mitigations
- Missing billing SKU: mark as manual approval and delay publish until billing selects SKU. Fast mitigation: use fallback SKU 'trial-default' and annotate listing with 'billing:manual' tag.
- Large images (>2MB) causing ingest timeouts: resize to 1280x720 and recompress to 200-400kb.
- Long headline truncation in catalog UI: shorten to 70 chars and move key terms to short description.
- Private deployment KMS flag omitted: set KMS_required=true in metadata and trigger security review.
- Links pointing to internal staging pages: replace with immutable public docs or attach internal flag and block publish.

Operational runbook (quick)
1) Partner or PM submits asset bundle to marketplace repo branch.
2) Auto-lint runs; if critical failures, bot comments PR.
3) GTM reviewer does lightweight acceptance using this checklist.
4) If accepted, label PR with 'ready-for-staging' and notify #marketplace-upload.
5) QA smoke tests run in staging; any failing checks become a blocker ticket.
6) On green, schedule publish window and record rollout owner.

Owner sign-off checklist (single-line items)
- Headline approved by PM
- Short description copy reviewed by content
- Icon and screenshots validated by design
- Billing SKU assigned by finance ops
- Trial entitlement validated by partner success
- Privacy/KMS requirements documented
- Linked artifacts and support contacts included

Rollout and rollback triggers
- Publish only during scheduled 2-hour window for reduced blast radius.
- Automatic rollback if click_to_trial_rate drops by 50% vs baseline in first 24h.
- Manual rollback if error rate for provisioning > 5% in first 100 trials.

A/B tile sample variants (short)
- Variant A (concise, pragmatic): Headline: 'Low-latency LLM inference'; Tagline: 'Pay per token or reserve capacity for stable throughput.'
- Variant B (feature-led): Headline: 'Autoscale GPU pools for production traffic'; Tagline: 'Canary rollouts, KV caching, and per-route analytics.'
- Variant C (enterprise trust): Headline: 'Isolated deployments, audited access'; Tagline: 'Bring-your-own-key, private control plane, SOC-ready logs.'

Design and imagery quick notes
- Keep screenshots free of customer data. Blur or synthesize examples.
- Architecture diagrams should be simplified, one-column flow, labeled components only.
- Icon must have clear center and 32px legibility. Provide a monochrome fallback.

Localization quick hits
- Reserve 70 char headlines to avoid overspill in DE/FR (approx 20% expansion).
- Short description should be translatable; avoid idioms.

Notes to reviewers (meta)
- This is intentionally brief to reduce friction for partner pilots. Use full listing pack for enterprise GA.
- If you find repeated friction in intake, propose a small automation to lint and correct common image/copy issues.

Example minimal PR template (use in repo description)
- What: short one-liner
- Owner: name + email
- SKU: internal-billing-sku-id
- Trial: true|false
- Screenshots: 2 attached
- Notes: any special privacy/region constraints

Contact for questions
- primary: claire.huang@redwood.ai
- support: partners@redwood.ai

End of kit
